hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI diagnostic kernel #14
inputs.revision: EmberBSD diagnostic OS source c7198a570027c7006d5e46ab7988d0fec319bb38; RAM-loaded kernel #14.

inputs.name: WPA2 association profile and selected AP
inputs.revision: WPA2 test against the same configured AP as the prior association trial; identifiers omitted.

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, run the WPA2 association profile against the same configured AP with the diagnostic RX-chain window enabled in kernel #14.
expected: The bounded window records entry counts at sta_input, crypto_decap, decap and sta_rx_eapol while preserving the WPA2 association and disconnect result.
observed: WPA2 association succeeded. Power save was WIFI_PS_NONE (enum 0). The RX diagnostic window started about 1.99 seconds before association and ran to about 10.30 seconds after association. The window restored and snapshotted counters; STA_DISCONNECTED reason 204 followed 14.5 ms later. Source ordering ties that event to the window closeout. The vendor reported a four-way handshake timeout. sta_input, crypto_decap, decap and sta_rx_eapol entry counters were all zero; no EAPOL frame or WPA_COMPLETED event was observed. Station identity cross-checks were consistent: ifconfig, wpa_cli status and the router station entry agreed; the selected SSID/AP0 agreed, and AP0 MAC matched the association BSSID. Raw addresses and network names are omitted. This identity match does not inspect hardware RX filter registers.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and one RAM-loaded diagnostic-kernel run; this does not establish another board revision or persistent Wi-Fi support.

Zero entry counts localize the first observed missing receive stage to before the instrumented sta_input entry. They do not establish whether an M1 was sent or received over the air, nor whether the runtime ROM function table or receive filters are correct.
The station/AP identity cross-check is consistent, but it does not read or validate hardware RX filter registers. AP per-station EAPOL transmit remains unconfirmed.
No EAPOL input, WPA_COMPLETED, negotiated PMF, IP address, DNS or accepted network data exchange was observed. Wi-Fi support remains partial.
